Specification: This specification models a single natural-number state variable i that starts at 0 and can increase by 1 while remaining below 5. The main behavior specification is Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_i, so the system allows Next steps and stuttering over i. The file also defines liveness test formulas involving universal quantification over an empty set and a singleton set, with comments explaining that one of these temporal formulas triggers a liveness-checking error in the tool.
StringLiterals: Temporal formulas containing actions must be of forms <>[]A or []<>A.
